description: Implementation of the ManufacturerService interface for managing manufacturer entities, including CRUD operations and retrieval methods related to manufacturers in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ManufacturerServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing business logic for managing Manufacturer entities, including CRUD operations, listing, and managing descriptions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Manufacturer entity after retrieval by ID.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products attached to a specific manufacturer.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Manufacturer entities associated with a specific store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with products in specific category IDs within a store, filtered by language.

methods.name: addManufacturerDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a manufacturer and associates it accordingly.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a Manufacturer entity based on presence of an ID.
